title: Diabetes subtree with ten properties per code (incl. normalForm)
exercises: $expand property= parent, child, inactive, sufficientlyDefined, moduleId, effectiveTime, three attributes, normalForm
why: Mixed: membership is one set, but each of 124 rows needs parent/child links, attribute rows and a computed normal form.
stresses: 124 rows x ~10 properties; normalForm is computed per concept; children are an inverse prop set

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org ignores the $expand property parameter and ValueSet.compose.property: no requested properties are returned (probed on /r4 and /r5, valueCode and valueString, 2026-11-01); it only adds a status property to non-active LOINC codes.
